Name: (AT and CP) Min's Retro Sewing Machine (2X1)
Author: miniveee
Description:
[center]I really, really liked the sewing machine mod by [b]Waterice[/b] (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15539]here[/url]﻿), but couldn't find a compatible mod for 1.6, nor a reskin created after the sewing machine was added as a furniture item in SDV. So, I made one myself!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/em4wbVS.png[/img]﻿

Adds the illusion of a 2x1 sewing machine, by replacing the [b]Sewing Machine[/b] and [b]Winter End Table[/b] with half of the texture each!

• [b]Vanilla[/b] - Matches the sewing machine found in Emily's house.
• [b]Idaida[/b]'s - Modified to fit the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9081]Idaida's Furniture Recolour[/url]﻿ by [b]idaida[/b].
• [b]Industrial[/b] - Modified to fit the style of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5444]Industrial Furniture Set[/url]﻿ by [b]DustyBeauty[/b].


[img]https://i.imgur.com/TG61lCi.png[/img]﻿

 1. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url]﻿, OR
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Install the latest version of Alternative Textures.[/url]﻿
3. Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
4. Run the game using SMAPI to play!

If you're using the [b]Content Patcher[/b] version of this file, a [b]config.json[/b] file will be generated upon first launch. You can manually edit this, or use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to select which style of sewing machine you'd like!

Cheers! Hope you enjoy.[/center]

Downloads.Description: A dedicated [AT] version of the sewing machine. Adds alternatives to the Sewing Machine (exclusively changed via use of the Paint Bucket) and Winter End Table.
